papers.abstract: We introduce Topological Neural Operators (TNOs), a principled framework for operator learning on cell complexes that lifts neural operators (NOs) from functions on points and/or edges to topological domains. TNOs represent data as features defined on cells of varying dimension and model their interactions through Discrete Exterior Calculus, enabling explicit cross-dimensional coupling via gradient-, curl-, and divergence-type operators. The key design principle is to decouple where information flows, as governed by fixed topological operators, from how it is transformed (which is learned), yielding models that respect the geometric support of physical quantities and expose conservation and compatibility structure. We further propose Hierarchical TNOs (HTNOs), which incorporate learned coarse complexes to propagate long-range and topology-dependent information. Our framework subsumes existing NOs as a special case, providing a unified perspective on operator learning across discretizations. Across a range of PDE benchmarks, including irregular-geometry flow problems, TNOs and HTNOs improve accuracy; controlled studies further isolate the benefits of native higher-rank and topological structure. Project page: https://circle-group.github.io/research/TNO
papers.title_zh: 拓扑神经算子
papers.abstract_zh: 我们引入了拓扑神经算子（TNO），这是一种用于细胞复合体算子学习的原则框架，它将神经算子（NO）从点和/或边上的函数提升到拓扑域。 TNO 将数据表示为在不同维度的单元上定义的特征，并通过离散外微积分对它们的交互进行建模，从而通过梯度、旋度和散度类型算子实现显式跨维度耦合。关键的设计原则是将信息流向（由固定拓扑算子控制）与信息的转换（学习）方式解耦，产生尊重物理量的几何支持并揭示守恒和兼容性结构的模型。我们进一步提出了分层 TNO（HTNO），它结合了学习的粗复合体来传播远程和拓扑相关的信息。我们的框架将现有的 NO 作为一个特例，为跨离散化的算子学习提供了统一的视角。在一系列 PDE 基准中，包括不规则几何流动问题，TNO 和 HTNO 提高了准确性；对照研究进一步分离了本地高阶和拓扑结构的好处。项目页面：https://circle-group.github.io/research/TNO

papers.title: Safe-RULE: Safe Reinforcement UnLEarning
papers.abstract: Offline safe reinforcement learning (Safe RL) enables policy learning without online interactions, making it suitable for safety-critical systems such as robotics systems. However, its reliance on static datasets exposes offline Safe RL to data poisoning attacks, where adversaries inject malicious samples that compromise safety and induce unsafe policy behavior. In this work, we propose a new learning paradigm, named safe reinforcement unlearning (Safe-RULE), used as a defense framework to remove the influence of poisoned data without retraining from scratch or requiring access to the original training environment. We further extend reinforcement unlearning to offline Safe RL by explicitly accounting for both task performance and safety constraints during the unlearning process. Experiments across benchmark Safe RL tasks demonstrate that our approach effectively enhances safety performance against data poisoning attacks.
papers.title_zh: 安全规则：安全强化学习
papers.abstract_zh: 离线安全强化学习（Safe RL）无需在线交互即可进行策略学习，使其适用于机器人系统等安全关键系统。然而，它对静态数据集的依赖使离线安全强化学习面临数据中毒攻击，攻击者会注入恶意样本，从而危及安全并引发不安全的策略行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的学习范式，称为安全强化取消学习（Safe-RULE），用作防御框架来消除中毒数据的影响，而无需从头开始重新训练或需要访问原始训练环境。我们通过在取消学习过程中明确考虑任务性能和安全约束，进一步将强化取消学习扩展到离线安全强化学习。跨基准安全强化学习任务的实验表明，我们的方法有效增强了针对数据中毒攻击的安全性能。

papers.title: Frequency-based Constrained Sampling for Interval Patterns
papers.abstract: Output space pattern sampling is a powerful alternative to exhaustive pattern mining for exploring large pattern spaces, as it enables users to focus on representative patterns drawn according to a chosen interestingness measure. In this paper, we address the problem of sampling interval patterns under user-defined syntactic constraints. We introduce CFips, a sampling approach that incorporates constraints directly into the sampling procedure. The approach relies on a multi-step sampling framework and supports several syntactic constraints by decomposing them into elementary predicates on interval bounds while preserving exact sampling guarantees. We formally prove that CFips samples interval patterns proportionally to their frequency within the constrained pattern space. The experimental results show that integrating constraints into the sampling procedure enables to complete mining tasks that would otherwise fail within a given time out.
papers.title_zh: 间隔模式的基于频率的约束采样
papers.abstract_zh: 输出空间模式采样是探索大型模式空间的详尽模式挖掘的强大替代方案，因为它使用户能够专注于根据所选兴趣度度量绘制的代表性模式。在本文中，我们解决了用户定义的语法约束下的采样间隔模式问题。我们引入 CFips，这是一种将约束直接纳入采样过程的采样方法。该方法依赖于多步采样框架，并通过将多种句法约束分解为区间边界上的基本谓词来支持多种句法约束，同时保留精确的采样保证。我们正式证明 CFips 在受限模式空间内按间隔模式的频率进行采样。实验结果表明，将约束集成到采样过程中可以完成原本会在给定时间内失败的挖掘任务。

papers.title: An Agency-Transferring Model-Free Policy Enhancement Technique
papers.abstract: Training reinforcement learning (RL) policies from scratch is   costly: it requires careful reward and environment design,   extensive tuning, and substantial computation.   Yet many control problems already have a functional but   suboptimal policy available as a baseline.   This paper proposes a method for embedding such a baseline into   the RL training process, simultaneously improving training   efficiency relative to from-scratch methods and producing a   learning policy that outperforms the baseline.   At each step, the method arbitrates between the baseline policy   and a trainable learning policy, initially relying strongly on   the baseline policy and then progressively transferring agency to   the learning policy.   By the end of training, the learning policy is a standalone   neural network that operates without baseline policy support.   The paper formalizes what it means for the baseline policy to be   functional: under this policy, the agent reaches a goal set and   remains there with high probability.   The proposed arbitration mechanism is designed to exploit this   property during training, yielding high goal-reaching rates right   from the beginning of training.   A theoretical analysis provides a formal interpretation of this   behavior under stated assumptions and extends it to the final   baseline-free regime, where explicit lower bounds are derived for   the goal-reaching probability of the standalone learning policy.   Empirical results on continuous-control benchmarks show that the   proposed method achieves returns that match or exceed those of   competitive approaches, while maintaining the highest   goal-reaching rates throughout training among the compared   methods -- including in the final stage, where the learning policy   operates without any baseline support.
papers.title_zh: 一种无代理转移模型的策略增强技术
papers.abstract_zh: 从头开始训练强化学习（RL）策略的成本很高：它需要仔细的奖励和环境设计、广泛的调整和大量的计算。   然而，许多控制问题已经有一个可行但次优的策略作为基线。   本文提出了一种将这样的基线嵌入到强化学习训练过程中的方法，同时相对于从头开始的方法提高了训练效率，并产生了优于基线的学习策略。   在每个步骤中，该方法都会在基线策略和可训练的学习策略之间进行仲裁，最初强烈依赖基线策略，然后逐步将代理转移到学习策略。   训练结束时，学习策略是一个独立的神经网络，无需基线策略支持即可运行。   该论文正式阐述了基线策略发挥作用的含义：在该策略下，智能体达到设定的目标并很有可能保持该目标。   所提出的仲裁机制旨在在训练期间利用这一特性，从训练一开始就产生较高的目标达成率。   理论分析在规定的假设下提供了对这种行为的正式解释，并将其扩展到最终的无基线制度，其中为独立学习策略的目标达到概率导出了明确的下限。   连续控制基准的实证结果表明，所提出的方法实现了与竞争方法相匹配或超过的回报，同时在比较方法中的整个训练过程中保持了最高的目标达成率——包括在学习政策在没有任何基线支持的情况下运行的最后阶段。

papers.title: Bandits for Efficient Experimentation: Adapting to Control Group, Preferences, and Context Drifts
papers.abstract: We consider a variant of the linear contextual stochastic multi-armed bandits, where the learner must provide recommendations to a group of users, each having its personalized preference vector, and in the presence of context distributions that are drifting over time. Under practitioner-friendly assumptions, we reduce this setting to linear bandit with stationary mean but heteroskedastic and non-stationary noise. We further study the case when the learner must ensure the mean reward of each decision must exceed that of a baseline strategy $\boldsymbolπ_0$ at each decision step. We introduce Dri-MED, an algorithm inspired from the linear version of the MED strategy, and carefully adapted to handle the non-stationary heteroskedastic noise. We show that the instance-dependent regret scales as $\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\fracκ{\tildeΔ}d^2(\log(T)\right)$, where $\tildeΔ$ is the constraint-aware sub-optimality gap subject to policy $π_0$, with variance-aware multiplicative term $κ$ that we carefully handle using heteroskedastic regression. We further show Dri-MED enjoys $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$ expected constraint violations. Our numerical results suggest that Dri-MED significantly outperforms conservative baselines that ignores the drift and preference structure.
papers.title_zh: 用于高效实验的强盗：适应对照组、偏好和环境漂移
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考虑线性上下文随机多臂老虎机的一种变体，其中学习者必须向一组用户提供推荐，每个用户都有其个性化偏好向量，并且存在随时间漂移的上下文分布。在对从业者友好的假设下，我们将此设置减少为具有平稳均值但异方差和非平稳噪声的线性老虎机。我们进一步研究学习者必须确保每个决策的平均奖励必须超过每个决策步骤的基线策略 $\boldsymbolπ_0$ 的情况。我们引入了 Dri-MED，这是一种受 MED 策略线性版本启发的算法，经过精心调整以处理非平稳异方差噪声。我们证明实例相关的遗憾尺度为 $\tilde{\mathcal O}\left(\fracκ{\tildeΔ}d^2(\log(T)\right)$，其中 $\tildeΔ$ 是受策略 $π_0$ 约束的约束感知次优差距，我们使用异方差回归仔细处理方差感知乘法项 $κ$。我们进一步表明 Dri-MED 喜欢$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d)$ 预期约束违规情况表明，Dri-MED 显着优于忽略漂移和偏好结构的保守基线。

papers.title: MeCo: One-Step MeanFlow-based Corrector for Multi-Channel Speech Separation
papers.abstract: While discriminative models for multi-channel speech separation excel in reference-based metrics, they often exhibit suboptimal human listening quality. To address this, we propose a novel MeanFlow-based one-step generative corrector (MeCo). MeCo learns a conditional average velocity field to map discriminative estimates directly onto the clean speech manifold in a single step. To maximize one-step generation performance, we introduce Data-Space Optimization (DSO). DSO integrates an $\mathbf{x}_r$-loss, which penalizes prediction errors on longer displacement intervals to serve as a generative objective for human listening quality, with an Endpoint SI-SDR loss that directly optimizes terminal signal fidelity. Experiments demonstrate that MeCo achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with minimal computational overhead, simultaneously achieving superior signal fidelity and human listening quality in both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios.
papers.title_zh: MeCo：用于多通道语音分离的基于 MeanFlow 的一步校正器
papers.abstract_zh: 虽然多通道语音分离的判别模型在基于参考的指标方面表现出色，但它们通常表现出次优的人类听力质量。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的基于 MeanFlow 的一步生成校正器（MeCo）。 MeCo 学习条件平均速度场，以一步将判别估计直接映射到干净的语音流形上。为了最大化一步生成性能，我们引入了数据空间优化（DSO）。 DSO 集成了 $\mathbf{x}_r$ 损失，它对较长位移间隔上的预测误差进行惩罚，作为人类收听质量的生成目标，以及直接优化终端信号保真度的端点 SI-SDR 损失。实验表明，MeCo 以最小的计算开销实现了最先进的 (SOTA) 性能，同时在域内和域外场景中实现了卓越的信号保真度和人类聆听质量。

papers.title: Visual Prompting Meets Feature Reconstruction-Based Anomaly Detection with Dual-Teacher Supervision
papers.abstract: Recent Anomaly Detection methods achieve perfect detection and segmentation scores on well-established datasets, such as MVTec. However, many of these methods face challenges when foundational assumptions - such as consistent object scale, viewpoint, background, illumination, and centered placement - are violated. Those variations that occur render anomaly detection methods unusable in many real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce three key contributions: (1) a visual prompting pipeline that isolates objects using foreground-background masking; (2) a mechanism for unfreezing the teacher in student-teacher models to improve domain adaptability; and (3) a data augmentation strategy leveraging diffusion-generated synthetic images to enhance anomaly detection performance. We achieve a 3.5 percentage point improvement over the previous state-of-the-art on the challenging AeBAD dataset by using the Masked Multiscale Reconstruction (MMR) model as our backbone.
papers.title_zh: 视觉提示与基于特征重建的异常检测和双教师监督相结合
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的异常检测方法在成熟的数据集（例如 MVTec）上实现了完美的检测和分割分数。然而，当违反基本假设（例如一致的对象比例、视点、背景、照明和居中放置）时，许多这些方法都面临挑战。发生的这些变化使得异常检测方法在许多现实场景中无法使用。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了三个关键贡献：（1）使用前景-背景遮蔽来隔离对象的视觉提示管道； （2）师生模型中解冻教师的机制，提高领域适应性； (3)利用扩散生成的合成图像来增强异常检测性能的数据增强策略。通过使用 Masked Multiscale Reconstruction (MMR) 模型作为我们的骨干，我们在具有挑战性的 AeBAD 数据集上实现了 3.5 个百分点的改进。

papers.title: Closure-Validated Circuit Discovery in Attention Heads: Co-activation Proposes, Ablation Disposes
papers.abstract: Interpretability increasingly treats groups of components, not individual units, as the basic object, and proposes to find them by clustering co-activation statistics. We ask whether such a cheap signal actually identifies an attention-head circuit. Adapting a sparse-autoencoder clustering recipe to attention heads -- but validating by causal ablation rather than reconstruction -- we cluster heads and then run a closure test: ablate the discovered community and compare per-example damage to matched-random controls. Across two dense 1B-scale models (Pythia 1B, OLMo 1B) and two input distributions, the communities pass closure. In a Mixture-of-Experts model (OLMoE-1B-7B), route-conditional clustering recovers a statistically real signal that nonetheless does not survive closure -- ablation improves loss, the wrong direction. Extending closure across training, attention-target selectivity and participation ratio decouple from function in both directions. We conclude that a cheap signal is a circuit proposal, not a confirmed circuit; closure is what separates them.
papers.title_zh: 注意力头中经过闭合验证的电路发现：共同激活提议，消融处置
papers.abstract_zh: 可解释性越来越多地将组件组而不是单个单元视为基本对象，并建议通过聚类共激活统计来找到它们。我们想知道这样一个廉价的信号是否真的可以识别注意力头电路。采用稀疏自动编码器聚类方法来适应注意力头——但通过因果消融而不是重建进行验证——我们对头进行聚类，然后运行封闭测试：消融发现的社区并将每个示例的损坏与匹配的随机控制进行比较。在两个密集的 1B 规模模型（Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B）和两个输入分布中，社区通过封闭。在专家混合模型 (OLMoE-1B-7B) 中，路由条件聚类恢复了统计上的真实信号，但该信号无法在闭合中幸存 - 消融会改善损失，这是错误的方向。将封闭范围扩大到培训、注意力目标选择性和参与率在两个方向上与功能脱钩。我们得出的结论是，便宜的信号是一个电路建议，而不是一个已确认的电路；关闭是他们分开的原因。

papers.title: Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol (CHAP)
papers.abstract: Foundation models are moving from response generation into operational roles. They plan across steps, call tools, request human input, coordinate with other agents, and increasingly carry responsibility for work that affects customers, claims, code, contracts, and clinical decisions. Production deployments are no longer one human supervising one model. They are multi-human, multi-agent collaborations that cross teams, time zones, and trust boundaries. The technical surface for this collaboration remains weakly specified. When an agent drafts a response and a human edits it before it ships, the moment of human judgement is the most valuable signal in the system. In current practice it is recorded, if at all, in application code, chat threads, ticket comments, and tribal memory. Two protocol standards address adjacent concerns: MCP standardises agent access to tools and data, and A2A standardises agent-to-agent interoperability. Neither defines the shared workspace in which humans and agents perform accountable work together. This paper presents CHAP, the Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol. Under CHAP, the override that used to vanish into a chat thread becomes a structured event carrying a diff, a rationale, and a content hash. The handoff between shifts becomes a portable envelope rather than a pinned message. The human approval of an agent's draft becomes a non-repudiable signed decision that can be replayed years later. The protocol achieves this through a small Core (workspaces, participants, tasks, artefacts, and an append-only evidence log) together with composable profiles that add review, modes, routing, deliberation, handoff, identity, signatures, and transparency-backed audit as deployments require them. Specification, reference implementation, conformance suite, and worked examples are available at: https://github.com/BrightbeamAI/chap
papers.title_zh: 人工代理协作协议 (CHAP)
papers.abstract_zh: 基金会模型正在从响应生成角色转向运营角色。他们跨步骤进行规划、调用工具、请求人工输入、与其他代理协调，并越来越多地承担影响客户、索赔、代码、合同和临床决策的工作责任。生产部署不再是一个人监督一种模型。它们是跨团队、跨时区和信任边界的多人、多代理协作。这种合作的技术面仍然不明确。当代理起草响应并在发布前由人工对其进行编辑时，人类判断的时刻是系统中最有价值的信号。在当前的实践中，如果有的话，它被记录在应用程序代码、聊天线程、票证评论和部落内存中。两个协议标准解决了相邻的问题：MCP 标准化了代理对工具和数据的访问，A2A 标准化了代理间的互操作性。两者都没有定义人类和代理一起执行负责任工作的共享工作空间。本文介绍了 CHAP，即协作式人类代理协议。在 CHAP 下，过去消失在聊天线程中的覆盖变成了带有差异、基本原理和内容哈希的结构化事件。轮班之间的交接变成了一个便携式信封，而不是一条固定的消息。代理人草稿的人工批准成为不可否认的签署决定，可以在数年后重播。该协议通过一个小型核心（工作空间、参与者、任务、工件和仅附加的证据日志）以及可组合的配置文件来实现这一目标，这些配置文件根据部署的需要添加审查、模式、路由、审议、移交、身份、签名和透明支持的审计。规范、参考实现、一致性套件和工作示例可从以下位置获取：https://github.com/BrightbeamAI/chap

papers.title: I Was Scrolling and Then I Saw a Pregnant Strawberry
papers.abstract: AI minidramas (also known as fruit dramas) are short, algorithmically distributed generative AI video series featuring anthropomorphized characters that have recently emerged as a widespread phenomenon on social media platforms. This paper argues that despite their seemingly innocuous aesthetic, these videos reproduce deeply gendered narrative structures in which female characters are systematically associated with moral transgression, sexual betrayal, and reproductive capacity, and that several plots also encode the logic of racialization, i.e., the process by which visible bodily difference is morally loaded. Drawing on feminist film theory, critical race theory, and platform studies, it further argues that the generative AI aesthetic of these videos, characterized by softness, roundness, and visual cuteness, functions as a mechanism of aesthetic laundering, neutralizing the ideological weight of these narratives and enabling their circulation despite content moderation systems. This paper approaches these questions through personal observation and close reading, reflecting on the specific affordances of generative AI that make this phenomenon both possible and culturally consequential for the field of computational creativity.
papers.title_zh: 我正在滚动，然后我看到了怀孕的草莓
papers.abstract_zh: AI 迷你剧（也称为水果剧）是一种简短的、通过算法分发的生成式 AI 视频系列，以拟人化的角色为特色，最近已成为社交媒体平台上的一种普遍现象。本文认为，尽管这些视频看似无伤大雅，但它们再现了深刻的性别化叙事结构，其中女性角色系统地与道德违规、性背叛和生殖能力联系在一起，并且一些情节还编码了种族化的逻辑，即可见的身体差异在道德上的加载过程。借鉴女权主义电影理论、批判种族理论和平台研究，它进一步认为，这些视频的生成式人工智能美学，以柔软、圆润和视觉可爱为特征，起到了审美清洗的机制作用，中和了这些叙事的意识形态重量，并使其在内容审核系统中得以传播。本文通过个人观察和仔细阅读来解决这些问题，反思生成式人工智能的具体功能，使这种现象成为可能，并对计算创造力领域产生文化影响。

papers.title: Beyond Probabilistic Similarity: Structural, Temporal, and Causal Limitations of Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Legal Domain
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard architectural response to unreliability in legal AI, yet high-profile failures, including fabricated citations submitted to courts and anachronistic legal content presented as current, continue to appear across jurisdictions. We argue that these failures are not residual confabulations to be eliminated by scaling language models, but symptoms of an architectural mismatch between probabilistic retrieval and the hierarchical, temporal, and institutional structure of legal knowledge. We develop the argument in three moves. First, we articulate the ontological commitment of legal knowledge as a triad of properties derivable from classical legal theory: hierarchical and mereological structure, diachronic dynamism under operational closure, and causal traceability of institutional provenance grounded in the duty of justification. Second, we identify three corresponding pathologies of retrieval (mereological blindness, diachronic blindness, and causal opacity), each developed with an operational definition, a failure mechanism, a canonical example, and detection criteria for diagnostic use. Third, we review the state of the art through this lens, showing that existing approaches address these requirements unevenly and do not yet compose into a paradigm that treats them as co-constitutive. From this analysis we derive four architectural commitments that characterize the deterministic-by-design direction for legal retrieval: ontological primacy, event reification, bitemporal correctness, and deterministic interaction protocols. The framework concerns quaestio juris (which norms apply and in what state) rather than the downstream tasks that act on identified norms, and addresses legislative and constitutional retrieval primarily, with interpretive time as an explicit extension.
papers.title_zh: 超越概率相似性：法律领域检索增强生成的结构、时间和因果限制
papers.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为针对法律人工智能不可靠性的标准架构响应，但引人注目的失败，包括向法院提交的伪造引文和当前呈现的不合时宜的法律内容，继续出现在各个司法管辖区。我们认为，这些失败并不是通过扩展语言模型来消除的残余混淆，而是概率检索与法律知识的层次、时间和制度结构之间的架构不匹配的症状。我们分三步展开论证。首先，我们将法律知识的本体论承诺阐明为源自古典法律理论的三个属性：等级结构和分体结构、操作封闭下的历时动力以及基于正当理由义务的制度起源的因果追溯性。其次，我们确定了三种相应的检索病态（分体失明、历时失明和因果不透明），每种病态都具有操作定义、失败机制、典型示例和诊断用途的检测标准。第三，我们通过这个视角回顾了现有技术，表明现有方法对这些要求的满足不均衡，并且尚未构成将它们视为共同构成的范式。从这个分析中，我们得出了四个架构承诺，这些承诺表征了法律检索的确定性设计方向：本体论首要性、事件具体化、双时态正确性和确定性交互协议。该框架涉及法律问题（哪些规范适用以及在什么状态下适用），而不是根据已确定的规范行事的下游任务，并主要解决立法和宪法检索问题，并以解释时间作为明确的延伸。
